facts.statement: The type locality of Daniatrogon is the Fur Formation.
Daniatrogon fossils were found in Denmark.
Daniatrogon is a genus and species that is new to science.
The taxonomic status of Daniatrogon is valid.
Daniatrogon was named by Mayr in 2026.
Daniatrogon lived during the Early Eocene.
Gerald Mayr is an author of the study describing the exceptional skeleton of an early Eocene trogon.
